decisions.reason: Selecting the PE name and license for endorsement does not change the required technical review, its extent, or its source documents.
This is a separate permit-drawing endorsement requiring a California license; the source resolves the PE identity for the as-built project and does not change the permit requirement.
The selected PE identity for stamping the as-built project does not change the separate permit project's electrical calculation obligation.
The source concerns an electrical PE license for the as-built endorsement and does not alter the separate HVAC calculation methods or Title 24 requirement.
Selecting the PE for the as-built endorsement does not change the separate obligation to create permit-ready electrical drawings.
The electrical PE identity selected for the as-built project has no necessary effect on the separate permit-ready mechanical drawing deliverable.
The electrical PE identity selected for the as-built project has no necessary effect on the separate permit-ready plumbing drawing deliverable.
